The 'twitch' zombie variant referenced in v3.1.17's excluded_experiments list remains isolated/PARTIAL, never integrated into canonical, unchanged this recovery -- still NOT present in this candidate's source.
what_changed_since_v3.1.17_candidate: ZSS-BUG-024 (Eastview lumber-pile / world-chunk exclusion causing a hard-freeze on pickup near a curb) FULLY RESOLVED at both the owner's original diner-curb report location and an independent west-curb retest -- the first genuine Normal-Play Trace (real served browser, normal WASD controls, no god-mode/no ?cap) achieved this recovery. Root cause was a real missing source fix (worldLumberPickup tag + world-chunk exclusion in v2.0-ec/src/world.js) that a prior cherry-pick had silently dropped -- caught and corrected before this publish, not merely claimed.

ZSS-BUG-030 (a genuine main-thread hard-stall from unbounded recursion in refreshCheatMark(), DEBUG_HARNESS-only reachable) root-caused and FIXED with a reentrancy guard in harness-controls.js, Codex-certified.

Sawer (Astra chainsaw mini-boss, Dev-Lab-only): the two gaps Product Grok named against the pre-fix build -- (1) the orange chainsaw not reading at a 20m night glance without crosshair-hunting, and (2) the fight reading as 'it stopped then rushed you' with no usable blade-up telegraph -- were both fixed (chainsaw housing color/emissive glow; a real held blade-up pose ~1.4s before the charge in the tele window) and independently RE-CERTIFIED PASS by the same Product Grok reviewer against the fixed build's own fresh evidence, not the original pack.

ZSS-BUG-029 (weapon audio): the owner's original multi-second shot-to-audible-onset delay complaint was retested with a new, more rigorous AudioContext.currentTime scheduling-lag measurement plus synchronized on-screen video, across 2,583 real-cadence shots -- worst observed onset delay was 15.3ms (MP5), nothing near a multi-second gap. This is NOT claimed as 'fixed': nothing in the audio-scheduling code changed, and one non-reproducing session cannot rule out an intermittent issue the owner experienced twice. Separately, an earlier scare of 41%/28% primary-gunshot silent-drop rates was root-caused as an overfire-rate testing artifact -- at real weapon cadence the primary silent-drop rate is 0%. A targeted fix for the real, still-open MP5/M4A1 secondary-audio-layer contention (57.7%/72.5% loss under crowded conditions) was attempted and then REVERTED after an independent Codex CERTIFYING review returned HOLD, finding the reserve mechanism was not protected against the same shot's own subsequent primary-layer request and that victim/eviction selection was not properly scoped -- this fix was not shipped uncertified and the underlying contention remains OPEN, disclosed below.

ZSS-BUG-032 registered and closed as non-defects after direct verification: RPG-7 carepackage-only availability is confirmed intentional design, not a bug; the noclip debug feature is confirmed real and player-facing (keybind N) and needs only discoverability, not a fix.
known_residuals_disclosed: ZSS-BUG-029 MP5/M4A1 secondary-audio-layer contention (57.7%/72.5% loss under crowded fire) remains OPEN. One fix attempt was reverted after a Codex HOLD identified two specific correctness gaps (same-shot primary theft of the admitted secondary; unscoped victim eviction) plus an unresolved real performance cost (2.47x-5.84x stall-fraction increase, not yet attributable to synthesis cost alone). A redesign addressing both correctness findings, ideally with a precomputed noise-buffer bank to cut synthesis cost directly, is needed before another attempt.

Player-death hard-freeze: a real, owner-reported-twice defect (Chrome 'Page Unresponsive' on player death; results screen showing zeroed run stats), previously root-caused as PARTIAL inside updateZombieAI(), was recovered as an unmet requirement during this recovery's reconciliation pass but has NOT been re-investigated or fixed this session. Carried forward as an open, disclosed item, not claimed fixed.

Pause-menu non-interactive mid-game: a real defect the owner confirmed live twice independently was recovered as an unmet requirement during reconciliation but has NOT been re-investigated this session (a prior source read found the escape-stack 'correctly implemented' on paper, contradicted by the owner's live evidence -- needs a fresh repro, not another code read). Carried forward as an open, disclosed item, not claimed fixed.

Sawer's own canonical keep/revert decision (should the Astra chainsaw mini-boss become a real integrated spawned enemy) remains explicitly unresolved by design -- this publish does not decide it. Sawer is reachable only through the Dev-Lab harness in this candidate, exactly as in prior candidates that excluded it entirely, except now with its two named readability/telegraph gaps fixed for whenever that decision is made.

WAVE 7+ ENCOUNTER, ZSS-BUG-020 (loot replenishment), ZSS-BUG-007 (compass/HUD alignment), and the ~20 test files outside recent lane scope: all carried forward unchanged from v3.1.17's own disclosed residuals list -- not re-tested this pass.

The pre-existing test-harness staleness gaps in parity-world-hash.cjs, worldlaw.js, audio.weapon.identity.resolve.js, audio.weapon.mapping.js, audio.foundation.js, and world.package.identity.js (vm-sandbox scope-capture gaps, not missing product declarations) were confirmed unchanged against a pre-session baseline commit and are not new to this candidate -- see docs/agent-runs/GG_WN3-recovery/pre-publish-regression-pass-2026-09-13.md in the source repo.
